description: issue #679 (SP7): the reserved-word rule covers struct CONSTRUCTORS as well as procedures (spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154 — "as variables, procedures, or struct constructors"), so with `sprites` active `struct tell`/`struct ask`/`struct each` each raise `ol-reserved-word` at the struct-name token. Scope note, verified not assumed: the `variables` third of that sentence is NOT diagnosed (`:tell = 1` checks clean) — but neither is `:repeat = 1` or `:if = 1` for Core reserved words, so that is uniform pre-existing behaviour of the `:name` namespace, not a Sprites-specific gap; it is reported to @orchestrator rather than fixed here, since parser source is outside this slice's write-set.

diagnostics.message: tell is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
ask is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
each is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
